name: Signy
title: Cook of the Working Terrace
examine: One wooden spoon, absolute authority. The mess terrace runs on her clock and everyone knows it, including the clock.
lines: Miners eat first, smiths second, opinions last.
I feed two hundred hands a day off two hearths and a temper. The temper does most of the seasoning.
Nobody works the terrace hungry. Not on my watch, not on anybody's.
